tree.heading: Law of salvage and law of finds
tree.text: The law of salvage and the law of finds shall not apply to abandoned shipwrecks to which section 2105 of this title applies.

tree.heading: Laws of United States
tree.text: This chapter shall not change the laws of the United States relating to shipwrecks, other than those to which this chapter applies.

tree.heading: Effective date
tree.text: This chapter shall not affect any legal proceeding brought prior to April 28, 1988.
